name: Midas
subject: Midas on RWAdar: your profile and a collaboration proposal
body:
Dear Midas team,

I am writing because Midas is listed on RWAdar, an independent radar for real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. I would like to invite you to review your profile and to explore how we could work together. I am not trying to sell you anything: being listed on RWAdar is free of charge, and so is working with us.

My name is Víctor Jorques, founder and CEO of RWAdar. I am 28 and from Valencia, Spain.

Your profile on RWAdar (in Spanish) explains what Midas issues – tokenised certificates on fixed-income strategies, issued by Midas Software GmbH under a base prospectus approved by Liechtenstein's FMA – and where to find your official documents: https://rwadar.pages.dev/plataformas/midas. We also have a dedicated page on mTBILL, covering what the certificate tracks (short-term US Treasury bills), what an investor acquires and where its prospectus and Spanish-language KID are published: https://rwadar.pages.dev/ofertas/mtbill

Like every profile on RWAdar, yours is written in Spanish for Spanish-speaking readers (the site interface is also available in English). It covers the risks too, and every data point carries its source and the date we checked it. Could you take a look? If anything needs correcting, please let us know with the official source and we will review it promptly.

Why it could be worth your while

• A free profile, in Spanish, that explains your product using your own official sources and links straight to your website.
• An independent, rigorous explanation designed to help investors understand what they are buying before they take the step.
• Up-to-date information: a direct line to us to update it whenever you launch something new or something changes.
• Investor education in Spanish: your product explained in plain language to people who are new to tokenization.

What we propose

• A contact person on your team and a direct line to correct data and tell us about new offerings, issuances, changes or regulatory news.
• Your feedback on your profile.
• Your official logo and images, only with your permission (the profile currently uses our own illustration).
• If useful to you, a plain-language explanation of your product or your case, in Spanish, in RWAdar Academy or our news section, under our own editorial judgement.

Working with us does not change the ranking or the risk warnings: that independence is exactly what gives your profile its value.

Our vision and how we work

We believe tokenization will be one of the biggest shifts in investing over the coming years: it can make assets that used to be reserved for a few accessible to more people. According to CoinGecko, the 30 largest tokenized products total more than USD 40 billion (12 November 2026). Yet it is still hard to understand: it is not always clear what investors are buying, who offers it, who can access it or what the risks are. RWAdar exists to explain this with clear, verifiable information.

• We cover 25 platforms and 22 specific offerings (as of 12 November 2026), with the official source and the date we checked it next to every data point, plus a list of platforms we have ruled out, each with its reason and source.
• We also offer market data, verified industry news, a calculator so people can run their own numbers and RWAdar Academy (nine lessons to help people understand investing in tokenized assets), on the website and in a free Android app.
• We are independent: we do not sell products, give advice or act as intermediaries, and we do not take orders or money from investors. Nobody can pay for a position in the ranking, a rating or the removal of a risk warning, and there are currently no sponsorships or commissions for sale (https://rwadar.pages.dev/transparencia-comercial, in Spanish).
• We work from primary sources: we re-check every offering before each publication, figures expire after seven days unless they are re-checked, and when something cannot be proven, we say so.

See RWAdar for yourself

• Website: https://rwadar.pages.dev
• Android app (free): https://rwadar.pages.dev/android
• On iPhone, the website can be added to the home screen and works like an app.

Could you tell me who the right contact person would be? A name and an email address are all I need. And if you are open to it, I would be glad to have a 20-minute call to get to know each other, at a time that suits you.

Thank you for your time.

Kind regards,

Víctor Jorques
Founder and CEO, RWAdar
rwadares@gmail.com · https://rwadar.pages.dev

RWAdar is run by Víctor Manuel Jorques Granero as an individual, based in Alzira (Valencia, Spain). Legal notice (in Spanish): https://rwadar.pages.dev/privacidad#aviso-legal

If you would rather not hear from us again, simply reply to this email or write to rwadares@gmail.com and we will not contact you further.
